name: Morón de la Frontera (Spain)
description: Blue field charged at the centre with the crowned arms of Morón de la Frontera (a white horse on red within an ornate yellow frame).
history: The flag of Morón de la Frontera is rectangular, blue, and bears the municipal arms; the reason for the blue of its ground and the date on which it was made official as the municipal flag are unknown.

features.role: Morón de la Frontera arms — white horse on red within an ornate frame
